topic: dtfile worker-response protocol validation and exact writes
fs_integration_state: SDK 0.3 remains frozen; receipt-authorized Apply remains disabled.

coverage: invalid descriptors and negative or truncated string lengths
oversized writes and exact field reads
negative, equal-to-count and valid update indices
complete tag, scalar and required-string checks in all three worker callbacks
optional zero-length error arguments remain valid

native_build.postcheck: make -n dtfile requested no compilation or link; ldd selected the established Motif ABI-9 runtime; no dtfile, make or compiler process remained.

component_checkpoint.command: taskset -c 1 make -j1 check-local in programs/dtfile against the staged candidate source

setup_diagnostics: The retained generated Makefile initially referenced its historical source tree, so the first checkpoint stopped at a missing current driver. Its source prefix was mechanically redirected to the retained staged candidate before the qualifying run.

The corrected checkpoint then found that the restore extractor did not link FileProcess.c after PipeWriteString acquired the exact-write helper. The driver dependency was fixed and its 77 cases passed before the final full checkpoint.
Final review preserved the established zero-length encoding for optional error arguments; the callback contract, changed FileOp object and complete checkpoint were requalified afterward.
Neither setup failure nor the pre-review checkpoint was treated as final qualification; the final staged-source checkpoint passed all 14 drivers.
limitations: The syscall seams exercise partial writes, interruption, zero writes and EPIPE deterministically; they are not native system-wide resource exhaustion tests.
This non-visual protocol bundle did not launch or inspect a CDE window.
Motif source fd5f4a74 was fetched and pinned without reviewing Motif changes. Qualification used the established Motif 20a ABI-9 runtime pending a matching qualified prefix.
